many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only

 "content": "def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    bg = max(set(x for row in grid for x in row), key=lambda x: sum(row.count(x) for row in grid))
    for i, row in enumerate(grid):
        # Mark the background cell immediately following a horizontal colored run
        # that reaches near the right edge; do not extend the marker across the tail.
        cols = [j for j, x in enumerate(row) if x != bg]
        if cols and max(cols) < len(row)-1 and all(row[j] == bg for j in range(max(cols)+1, len(row))):
            out[i][max(cols)+1] = 1
    return out
